Understanding prayer times in Muscat

Muscat follows Asia/Muscat for the city centre. Salati uses its stored Muscat calendar for the covered dates in October 2026 and regional calculations outside that coverage; the source line identifies the timetable in use. Central Muscat does not represent every governorate in Oman. Seeb and more distant districts can differ, so consult the local timetable when travelling.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
